items.title: Objection (Einspruch) against Kindergeld decision
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Musterfulda erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date, so posting day = 19.11.2026. Familienkasse Kindergeld decisions follow the tax-office delivery rule (§108 Abs.3 AO analogy): delivery is on the 4th day after posting, moved to next working day if that falls on a weekend/holiday. 19.11 +4 days = Mon 23.11.2026, which is a normal working day, so delivery (Bekanntgabe) = 23.11.2026. One-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO) runs from the day after delivery and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NW, so no shift under §108 Abs.3 AO.
